name: ui_find
description:
Find UI elements. REQUIRED before clicking elements you haven't located yet. Returns element IDs for use with ui_click.
Finds UI elements by name, type, ID, or other criteria. Returns element IDs for clicking, typing, etc. You MUST call this tool or ui_click for every UI operation - never skip tool calls. REQUIRED: windowHandle (from window_management tool). For Electron/Chromium, visible text and ARIA labels usually show up here as element names.
Returns: The result containing list of found elements with their properties and element IDs.

windowHandle.description: Window handle as decimal string (from window_management 'find' or 'list'). REQUIRED.

name.description: Element name (exact match, case-insensitive). For Electron apps and Chromium browsers, this is often the visible label or ARIA label.

nameContains.description: Substring to search in element names (case-insensitive). Preferred for dialog buttons - e.g., 'Don\\'t save'.

namePattern.description: Regex pattern to match element names. Use for complex matching like 'Button [0-9]+' or 'Save|Cancel'.

controlType.description: Control type filter (Button, Edit, Text, CheckBox, ComboBox, Menu, MenuItem, etc.)

automationId.description: AutomationId for precise matching (exact match, most reliable).

className.description: Element class name (e.g., 'Chrome_WidgetWin_1' for Chromium, 'Button' for Win32).

exactDepth.description: Exact depth to search (1=immediate children). Skips other depths, improves performance.

foundIndex.description: Return the Nth match (1-based, default: 1). Use 2 for second match, etc.

includeChildren.description: Include child elements in response (default: false).

sortByProminence.description: Sort results by size (largest first). Useful for disambiguation.

inRegion.description: Filter to region: 'x,y,width,height' in screen coordinates.

nearElement.description: Find elements near this elementId (results sorted by distance).

includeDiagnostics.description: Include diagnostics (timing, query, elements scanned) in response. Default: false.
